quick: "Dermatologist recommended" has no official standard in India; it is mostly a marketing label. Choose a night cream with a full ingredient list, a texture for your skin type and realistic claims, use a pea-sized amount nightly, wear sunscreen each morning and patch test first.
facts: No official standard exists for the "dermatologist recommended" label
"Dermatologically tested" usually means checked for irritation, not results
A gentle night cream is fine every night
Start retinol or acid creams 2–3 nights a week
